nodes.question: What methodologies are explored in land management research as per the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Land management research explores the incorporation of MCA methods combined with Geo-tools like GIS and in the form of Spatial MCA, which considers criteria related to biodiversity, ecosystem services, and resilience.
nodes.paragraph: Among these applications, it is possible to highlight the use of MCA to compare and select green and gray infrastructure for flood risk reduction and management, considering also environmental and social co-benefits [ 19 21], to integrate 1 3 Circular Economy and Sustainabilitystakeholders preferences into planning of NBS for managing hydro-meteorological risks at the river basin scale [ 19], and to select best management practices in stormwater best management practices involving conflicting stakeholders [ 22]. Bousquet et al. (2023) [ 23], present a comprehensive review of MCA applications in NBS planning and among 124 reviewed papers they evidence the lack of stakeholders involvement in the MCA process through participatory workshops. From the selected papers, none refer to the involvement of municipal or citizen representatives, nor do they incorporate private sector professionals. Land management research has widely explored the incorporation of MCA methods, either with combination with Geo-tools, such as GIS [ 24, 25], or in the form of Spatial MCA [ 26, 27], allowing the incorporation of criteria related to biodiversity, ecosystem services or resilience for identification of best strategies to implement ecosystem restoration or urban greening practices.

nodes.question: What is the main focus of the F.A.O. Global Soil Partnership 2012-2022 regarding sustainable soil management?
nodes.answer: The main focus of the F.A.O. Global Soil Partnership 2012-2022 is to implement sustainable soil management practices.
